mapper.sql: id, code, name, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM permission ORDER BY id
SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.remark, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT p.code FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE r.code = #{roleCode} ORDER BY p.code
